scientific_question: Can two source networks with exactly the same final source identities, A/B/M landscape and equilibrium reachable union retain different distributional histories solely because the sources became active in a different order?

latent_landscapes.reuse: the exact 384 v18/v19 directed truth graphs, A/B permissibility fields, outlet definitions and frozen three-source clustered/dispersed source sets

histories.H_anchor_first: sources ordered exactly as the frozen v18 source tuple: source0 at t0, source1 at t2, source2 at t4
histories.H_second_first: source1 at t0, source2 at t2, source0 at t4
histories.H_third_first: source2 at t0, source0 at t2, source1 at t4

propagation_semantics.directed_graph: the frozen v18 directed truth graph
propagation_semantics.edge_time: one structural propagation step per directed edge
propagation_semantics.occupied_by_time_t: node is occupied if at least one source arrival time <= t
propagation_semantics.equilibrium_occupancy: union of all nodes reachable from at least one final source
propagation_semantics.earliest_origin_set: source or sources minimizing activation_time + BFS distance at the node
propagation_semantics.static_origin_set: all final sources from which the node is reachable regardless of activation time

checkpoints.equilibrium_checkpoint: row-specific maximum finite source arrival time across all three histories and all union-reachable nodes

primary_outputs: transient occupied fraction by activation history
pairwise transient occupancy Jaccard distance among histories
fraction of equilibrium nodes whose earliest-origin set differs among activation histories
fraction of equilibrium nodes whose unique earliest source changes among histories
clustered versus dispersed contrasts in transient occupancy sensitivity and provenance-memory sensitivity

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design has different transient occupied sets among the three activation histories at t=6.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if transient occupancy is history-invariant everywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row/design, all three activation histories converge to exactly the same equilibrium occupied node set.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design has identical equilibrium occupancy but different earliest-origin assignments among activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if provenance is history-invariant whenever occupancy converges.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Pooled mean pairwise transient occupancy Jaccard distance is strictly larger for dispersed than clustered source placement.
Pooled mean equilibrium earliest-origin disagreement fraction is strictly larger for clustered than dispersed placement.
For both placement designs, pooled mean earliest-origin ambiguity is lower than pooled mean static-origin ambiguity, while at least one row retains nonzero earliest-origin ambiguity.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any placement design without strict reduction or if no residual ambiguity remains anywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/design has the same final source set and equilibrium occupancy but at least two distinct equilibrium earliest-origin maps among the three histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if equilibrium provenance map is unique for every final source set.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one row/design has zero equilibrium occupancy difference but positive equilibrium provenance-memory fraction.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if provenance differences occur only when occupancy still differs.

secondary_outputs: time from last activation until occupancy convergence
time from last activation until earliest-origin assignments stabilize
relationship between v19 static confluence fraction and v21 provenance-memory fraction
relationship between v18 coverage-insurance geometry and history sensitivity
effect modification by barrier density, environmental autocorrelation and neighbourhood
claim_boundary: Activation times are structural ordering devices, not calibrated years or generations.
Earliest-origin identity is a graph-theoretic provenance label, not empirical ancestry.
Persistent occupancy after arrival is a synthetic colonization-memory assumption for this experiment.
The experiment does not model abundance, local extinction or demographic source strength.
stop_rules: Do not change the activation-time multiset after scoring.
Do not add a fourth activation history after scoring.
Do not change the transient checkpoint after scoring.
Do not add extinction or decay after scoring to rescue a failed memory hypothesis.
